en-US.author: Reliant Labs, Inc.
en-US.description: A complete agentic environment with remote connections, workflow-based chats, and more.
en-US.longDescription:
Reliant is a desktop AI coding assistant that goes beyond chat. Interact with your codebase through natural conversation, then extend that interaction with programmable workflows that automate complex, multi-step development tasks.

Key Features:
- Chat with your codebase — AI understands your project structure, reads files, and maintains context across conversations.
- Programmable workflows — define repeatable multi-step processes in YAML and version them with your code.
- Multi-agent patterns — spawn parallel agents, implement debate patterns, or chain specialized agents together.
- Git worktrees — isolate work in separate branches without switching contexts.
- Any LLM provider — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Groq, OpenRouter, and more.
- MCP support — extend capabilities with Model Context Protocol servers.
- Config as code — workflows and presets live in your repository as .reliant/ files.
en-US.name: Reliant

zh-CN.description: 具备远程连接、工作流式对话等功能的完整智能体开发环境。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Reliant 是一个不止于对话的桌面 AI 编码助手。你可以通过自然对话与代码库交互，并借助可编程工作流将这种交互扩展为自动化复杂的多步骤开发任务。

主要特性：
- 与代码库对话 — AI 理解你的项目结构，可以读取文件并在对话间保持上下文。
- 可编程工作流 — 用 YAML 定义可重复的多步骤流程，并随代码一起版本化。
- 多智能体模式 — 派生并行智能体、实现辩论模式，或将多个专职智能体串联起来。
- Git worktree — 在独立分支中隔离工作，无需切换上下文。
- 任意 LLM 提供商 — Anthropic、OpenAI、Google Gemini、GitHub Copilot、AWS Bedrock、Azure、Groq、OpenRouter 等。
- MCP 支持 — 通过 Model Context Protocol 服务器扩展能力。
- 配置即代码 — 工作流和预设以 .reliant/ 文件的形式存放在你的仓库中。
